hook: A daily kitchen staple just triggered a recall of 5.9 million units.

sections.voiceover: A daily kitchen staple just triggered a recall of 5.9 million units.
On October 29, 2026, federal officials announced a recall of Bodum French press coffee makers. Which flaw affected 5.9 million coffee makers?
But it's worse: 8 distinct models feature replaceable glass carafes that break during use.

Bodum USA confirmed the replaceable glass carafe can break during operation. Structural breakage causes severe hot coffee spills and serious burn injuries. Safety authorities flagged 8 separate models across the product line.
That puts 5.9 million dangerous coffee makers under official recall.
